guard: xlsx-carrier — the positive control: a well-formed workbook of inline strings is accepted and yields its rows
xlsx-zip-ratio — one worksheet entry of 2 MiB of zeros expands about 1 000:1, over the 20:1 cap
xlsx-zip-size — one selected worksheet entry expands to 33 MiB, over the 32 MiB single-part cap, at about 7:1 so only the size guard can fire
xlsx-zip-entries — the archive declares 1 001 entries, over the 1 000-entry cap
xlsx-xml-dtd — the worksheet part declares a DOCTYPE with an external entity, which the reader profile prohibits
xlsx-macro — the package carries xl/vbaProject.bin and a macro-enabled workbook content type, refused before a sheet is parsed
xlsx-zip-entry-name — an entry is named ../evil.xml, so no normalized name can leave the archive root
